5)༄༅/rgyal dbang dpal yul ba'i 'dus sde'i tshogs sgrigs bslab bya kun bzang rnam par rol ba'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /6)oṃ dge legs su gyur

tei:div.tei:p: 5)༄༅/ rgyal dbang dpal yul ba'i 'dus sde'i tshogs sgrigs bslab bya kun bzang rnam par rol ba'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// 6) oṃ dge legs su gyur cig rkang gnyis gtso bo lha mi'i bla ma mi yi seng ge don kun grub// zhi ba chags bral nyon mongs gdung sel lung dang rtogs pa'i dam pa'i chos// tshogs kyi zhing mchog sa lam la gnas rig grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun bcas// rin chen gsum zhes grags pa'i gdugs dkar tshangs gnas lhun po'i rtse na brjid// dus gsum kun mkhyen padma rje'i// ring lugs nyin byed snang ba 7)ches// phan bde'i nyin mor 'byed mdzad pa// kun bzang shes rab yab sras rgyal// de la 'dir gangs can gyi ljongs na snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i ring lugs pa chen po/ stod rdor smin/ bar zhe rdzogs/ smad kaḥdapal zhes yongs su grags pa'i ya gyal grub brnyes bye ba'i 'byung gnas shar rgyal ba dpal yul ba zhes chu 'go brgya yi grol phugs yin pas sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar/ rjes 'jug 8) gang zag gi nyams len/ tshogs bca' bsgrigs 'don phyag bzhes rigs phyogs mthar khyab pa'i chos brgyud grub mtha' 'dzin pa kun gyis dper blang lo ba zhig ma byung na phan pa med pas tshogs bsgrigs rags bsdus tsam snyan du gsol ba la/ thog mar cho ga gang la 'jug pa'i tshe yang rten gyi dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sar/ rdul phyag rgyan bkram/ mchod pa'i tshogs rnams bkod pa khyad 'phags kyi bkram pa'i phug ngos su rdo rje rgyal po'i khri/ gdangs gral g.yas pa la/ rgyal tshab dang*/ rgyal theb gnyis/ byang 'dren chen po dang*/ dbu g.yog gnyis gdangs gral g.yon pa la/ rgyal theb gsum/ skad len pa/ skad g.yog gnyis/ de 'phros gdangs gral gnyis/ de'i rgyab tu rtsa gral g.yas g.yon gnyis/ de rgyab tu rgyal gral g.yas g.yon gnyis bcas la dge 'dun gnyis re'i rgyab tu rnga gdan khar 9)rnga gnyis brtsegs khar rnga yab gnyis re/

rnga yu gnyis gshibs gral gdan steng drang thad 'ong bar 'jog gdangs gral gnyis kyi 'jug tu dung dkar ba re re/ rtsa gral gnyis kyi 'jug tu rnga chen re re/ rgyal gral g.yon pa'i rgyab tu/ rgya gling pa gnyis/ dung chen pa gnyis/ gral 'jug g.yas g.yon gang ba der dge bskos dpon g.yog de dag la khri gdan sogs gang 'os dang*/ dkyil 'khor yang cho ga gzhan la bdag mdun zhal sprod/ kar gling zhi khro la dkyil 'khor zhal slob ma la ston pa dgos pas/ gang ltar yang rdul tshon nam ras bris tshad ldan steng*/ dbang rdzas/ sgrub rdzas thams cad ma tshang ba med pa/ gtor ma rnams rgyan spros phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sogs mdor na gsang sngags lag len gyi mtha' can yin pas/ cho ga'i chings phra mo nyams kyang dngos grub bsgrub 10)pa'i go skal chad pas/ phra zhing phra ba nas brgyud ldan bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes khungs ma las zhun thar bcad de sbyang brtson drag pos 'bad pa las/ rang gzo hob tshod sla chos sogs ni rnam pa kun tu mi rung ba gzhir bzhag nas/ tho rangs dang po rgya rnga btang ba dang rang rang gi grwa shag nas bzhengs te na bza' bzhes/ de yang mnab shams dang 'gag ring gi mtha' ring thung med pa bre kha bcad pa lta bu/ ha cang 'jol ba rkang rteb la reg pa ma yin pa/ ha cang brdzes pa nya yu mthong ba ma yin par/ g.yas chags/ g.yon chags/ mdun chags/ rgyab chags rnams dam pa'i chos 'dul ba dang mthun par mnab/ gzan yang ther phrug gam snam bu dmar mdog can las kan da dang 'bu ras sogs mi chog pa gzhir bzhag nas/ de yang zheng chungs/ ha cang 'jol ba gos mthar sleb pa sogs ma yin par mnabs/ sgrub mchod sogs 11)dmigs gsal dpung bcad mi dgos pa'i tshe rngul len dang stod 'bog sogs kyang dmar ser mdog can las/ rngul len dkar po 'di khyim pa rgad po rgad mo'i gos yin pas rab byung gis mnab na/ khyim rtags spangs ba las nyams/ rab byung gi rtags blangs ba las nyams/

mkhan por gsol btab las nyams pa ste/ nyams pa rnam pa gsum gcig char 'byung ba yin pas rnam pa kun tu mnab mi chog de nas gzan gal khyer dang bcas/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ sgrub mchod sogs dus/ dril gdan/ nang mchod rnams dang*/ spyi la'ang*/ dbu zhwa/ nyin re gsol tshod shong ba'i tshogs khug sgrigs zhal/ cho ga rang rang gi dpe cha/ de steng dge tshul slong rnams nas/ chos gos/ gding ba/ lhung bzed dang bcas te/ thog dung gnyis pa 'go len nas phebs/ 12)sgo khang du 'du/ mchil lh+wam phud/ dge bskos kyis spos bam gyis sna drangs/ chab ril pa gnyis kyis sgo g.yas g.yon nas chab 'bul bzed bcas gzan zlum khyer gyis gtsug lag khang gi nang du zhugs/ 'di nas bzung tshogs ma gral gyi bar du ngag bcad dgos/ nang du phyin nas sgo kha nas tshul phyag gsum re 'tshal nas rang gi gro du bzhengs/ dge tshul slong rnams kyi chos gos gsol/ gding ba bzhi lteb kyis bting*/ dge tshul slong sdom pa dang ldan pa rnams gral mgo phyogs dang*/ dge bsnyen khyim pa rnams gral 'jug phyogs te bslab gral ma nor bar bsgrig 'dus pa thams cad 'dzoms nas gral phyag lan gsum 'tshal nas/ lhan gcig tu gzan zlum khyer kyi g.yon pas dpang bkab nas gral du bzhugs/ de'i tshe yang*/ g.yas blta/ g.yon blta/ dgye nas rgyab brten pa/ sgur nas 13)sdod pa sogs ma yin par mdun ral gris bcad pa lta bu/ rgyab mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bu/ lus gnad drang seng nge ba/ zur nas 'jal na/ pus mo'i thad/ sku rgyab/ mdun thams cad thig 'phen pa lta bu/ ya yo khyag khyog med par bzhugs pa dang*/ sgo kha sogs nas bltad mo'i rigs byed ci 'dra ba byung yang*/ de phyogs gzigs pa sogs mi mdzad par/ bzhugs mal du lus/ lus na sems/ sems la lhod chags par dran shes bag yod dang ldan par dad ldan dwang ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan du gyur par bzhugs/

de'i tshe mnab gzan g.yas pa'i phyogs phrag g.yas pa nas nang du 'then nas bzhugs pa rang re rnying ma ba'i tshogs bsgrigs yin/ de nas thog dung gsum pa 'go len pa dang byang 'dren gyi 'go bskul ba sogs kyis dus/ kha gdangs nas zer ba dang*/ skad ha cang bsgrad 14)ches pa dang*/ mchu yis las bzhi'i dbyibs btod pa sogs ma yin pas/ mgrin pa bkugs/ mchu btsum pa lta bus/ khong pa'i gding nas gre skad ldi ri ri gtong ba las/ rdo sbal grags pa lta bu'i khrag sgra can/ skad yod tshod phyungs ba lta bu'i 'bod skad can ma yin par tshig 'go cung dma' ba lta bur blangs na tshogs pa bying skad dma' nas ra skad lug skad mi mdzad pa la phan/ de yang tshogs pa byings nas kyang dbu mdzad kyi skad der bsgrigs nas 'u ru ru 'don pa las/ skad ha cang che ba'i tshogs 'bod/ skad ha cang chung ba'i rang skad rang gi mi thos pa sogs ma yin par/ dbu mdzad kyis gsungs pa la rna ba gtad nas tshig gcig sngar ma song*/ tshig gcig phyir ma song bar sgrig ci thub byed pa las/ ra skad lug skad tshogs 'bod sogs rnam pa kun tu mi chog grwa chung 15)rnams tshogs gral du yod pa'i tshe yang*/ da nang nas do dgong bar la skad dam lhod med par 'don pa las/ skabs rer 'bod ci thub/ skabs rer go rgyu med pa sogs dang*/ rtsed mo'i rigs tshogs gral du sne gcig byed mkhan yon na/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dus su lus ngag rtsod/ ces gsang sngags kyi sbom po brgyad kyi nang tshan gyi nyes pa yin pas che chung kun nas 'dzem/ shangs tha sogs mchod dgos mkhan dang*/ snabs phyi ba sogs kyi tshe gzan gyis dbu gtum pa las mthong bzhin du mi mdzad/ mdun du dril gdan yod pa'i tshe'am/ min kyang*/ dril bu zhal mdun bstan rang gi lag g.yon kyi phyogs dang*/ rdo rje lag g.yas kyi phyogs/ de'i g.yas su ḍā ma ru leb bzhag byed/ dril bu'i g.yas phyogs dang rang gi g.yon phyogs su nang mchod bzhag pa 'di gtso cher

16)bka' ma phyogs la de ltar dgos/ gter ma'i rang lugs dus/ ḍā ru dgongs bzhag rdo rje dril bu bsnol nas bzhag rgyu de gtso bo yin/ rdor dril bsnol nas bzhag yod pa'i tshe lag gnyis bsnol nas yar blang mar bzhag dgos/ rdor dril rnying ma spyi ltar bzhag yod pa'i tshe/ lag g.yas kho nas rdor dril gnyis ka blang*/ pang du sleb dus dril bu lag g.yon la gtad dgos/ nam yang dril lces sgra med par blang bzhag 'jam tha le bar mdzad dgos/ rdo rje ma blangs bar dril bu 'khrol ba dang*/ lag g.yas kyi dril bu 'khrol ba sogs rnam pa kun tu mi mdzad/ dril bu 'khrol ba'i tshe yang*/ rdo rje gsor nas dril bu 'khrol ba gter ma rang lugs tshe gal che/ bka' ma sogs dus spyan 'dren rnams kyi tshe rdo rje gsor/ gzhan thams cad la rdor yol kho na shas che/ 17) rdo rje dril bu 'di gsang sngags kyi dam rdzas che shos yin pas 'gom yug sogs ma song bar gus pa dang bcas pa dgos/ 'khrol ba'i tshe lag par lhod chags pas dal gyi 'khrol ba las shed kyi 'khrol mi nyan pa dang*/ dbu zhwa bzhes pa'i tshe yang lag g.yas pas bzung te dbu la bzhes pa las/ lag gnyis kas bzung ste gyon na sprang po zhwa gyon zer ba yin pas mi mdzad/ gzan dang chos gos bzhes pa'i tshe lag g.yas phyogs nas g.yas skor gyis bzhes/ phud dus g.yon nas g.yas phyogs su snga ma las lugs ldog tu bya/ ber sogs mnab dus g.yas su gdeng te g.yon nas mnab dgos/ chos gos gzan dang sbyar ba las kher rkyang dang*/ so sor mnab mi nyan/ dbu mdzad pa rnams nas kyang*/ sku lus drang por bsrangs te/ ya yo khyag 18)khyog med par bzhugs nas/ rol mo 'khrol ran dus/ byang 'dren chen mos/ phyag g.yas pas zhabs rol blangs te/ phyag g.yon par gtad/ de'i phyag g.yon pas rol lung mdzub gung bar du bzung ba la 'phya srol yod pas/ mi bzung bar rol lung mdzub mo'i steng du mar dpyang*/

phyag g.yas pas steng rol blangs te/ thang thang blang ba dang lhan gcig g.yas gral pa rnga pa yongs rdzogs kyi/ gong ma rnga dpon/ 'og ma rnga g.yog re re bzhin spel ma yin pas/ rnga dpon thams cad kyis/ rnga g.yas phyogs nas blangs ste g.yon gyis dpus mo'i thad du/ rang gi dpral ba'i sgang*/ rnga yi sgang dang*/ pus mo'i sgang gsum sprad nas bslang*/ de'i sngon du rnga g.yog pa so sos rnga g.yug gnyis re rgyab nas blangs ste/ rnga dpon dang*/ rang gi mdun du zla gam nang bstan du bzhag 19)dgos/ de dag gi tshe sgra med par 'jam tha le ba dgos/ skad len dpon g.yog dang*/ rol g.yog pas rol mo len pa'i tshe/ rnga g.yog pa bying gis rnga bslang dgos pas/ de'ang g.yon gral gyi rnga dpon pa rnams kyis rnga g.yon phyogs nas blangs ste bslang*/ bzhag dus kyang de ltar te/ rol g.yog pa rnams kyis rol mo 'jog pa dang lhan gcig rnga g.yog pa byings nas sngar len pa'i go rim bzhin/ rnga gral g.yas pas lag g.yon phyogs dang*/ rnga gral g.yon pas g.yas su bzhag dbu chen pas rol tshag len pa dang*/ rnga dpon pa byings kyis rnga gral g.yas pas g.yas phyogs dang*/ rnga gral g.yon 20)pas g.yon phyogs su sgra med par dal bar 'jog mdor na rnga dpon rnga g.yog gnyis kyi bar du/ rnga yu gnyis gshib drang tha le 'ong bar 'jog dgos/ rnga bzung dus lus lhod/ lag lhod/ brdung dus lhod pa lhod ste gsum phab nas/ ri bo'i rtse mi bshig ces steng du mi brdung*/ seng ge'i 'gram pa mi bcag zhes g.yas g.yon mi brdung*/ rgya mtsho'i gting mi dkrug ces dkyil drang por mi brdung*/ brdung na sbrul tshang steng zhes pas dkyil smad sor bzhi'i mtshams yin/ gshar 'don dus/ tshig rnga rang thos zhes rang re snga 'gyur rnying ma pa'i ngag rgyun lags pas/ tshig rang gis bdon pa rang gi rna bar thos tsam dang*/ rnga rang gis brdungs ba rang gi rna bar thos tsam dgos pa yin/

rol mtshams rnga'i brdung rnams la'ang bsgrigs rnga thog gi a long mi 'gul ba tsam las cher 21)mi brdung*/ rnga chen pa gnyis nas tshig 'don dus brdung mi dgos/ rol mtshams rnams la sgra grags nges che bar brdung dgos/ de'ang shed yod do cog phyung nas shing gcod pa lta bu ni ma yin/ gdangs ring po btang dus rnga g.yug gi mthil rnga ngos su kha sbyar la bzhag rnga yu tshon ma yin na gzan gyis lcib nas 'dzin pa las rjen par mi bzung*/ lag g.yas pas skyil krung bsnol mtshams nas lag mgo kho na 'gul ste brdung ba las/ lag pa gru mo phan g.yug pa dang*/ brang la khu tshur rdeg pa lta bu mi mdzad/ mtshams rol bzhag nas/ tshig lhug sogs bton te yang bskyar brdung ma ran bar lta bu la/ rnga g.yug lag g.yon pa'i gung srin bar du zla gam nang bstan gyis bzung*/ mdor na gral mtha' gral mgo 22)gang nas bltas kyang*/ mdun rgyab nas thig skud brkyang ba lta bu drang tha le ba/ rnga rnams gcig gis gcig ma sgribs par zla gam nang bstan rnams la che chung med pa dang*/ rnga sgang sprod sogs mi gcig gis bzung ba lta bu gra 'grigs pa/ rnga brdung dus kyang mi gcig gis brdung ba ltar las che chung ma song ba dgos/ bka' ma'i phyag bzhes sogs la dbyangs ring rnga yod pa'i phyogs la rol mos rtse len thang thang ma zin pa'i bar rol dpang thog bzhag la nye bar tshig gi ngos la zhugs dus rnga phog dgos pa sogs dmigs bsal re byung yod/ gsol ja bzhes thug sogs nam bzhes pa'i tshe yang rnga rol bzhag nas bzhes pa las rnga bslang bzhin/ rol pang du yod bzhin du bzhes pa'i srol med/ ja thug nam yod kyang ja mchod tshig bzhi re tsam med par mi bzhes/ ja bzung ba'i 23)tshe lag gnyis kas gsol zhal 'degs bzhin du bzung*/ de nas thang la bzhag ja mchod dus lag gnyis kas blangs te bzung*/ gsol ba'i tshe sgra med par dal bus gsol/ lhag par thug pa gsol ba'i tshe/

tshag tshag hob hob sogs kyi sgra dang bcas pa ma yin par dal bus sgra med par bzhes dgos/ gung tshigs gsol tsam sogs bzhes pa'i tshe yang sgra med par dal bus bzhes pa las/ kha gdangs pa/ sgra dang bcas pa/ mkhur spo ba/ skan tog pa sogs ma yin par 'dul ba'i kun spyod la bslab/ gro thug bzhes pa'i tshe yang*/ thams cad gsol ba las gsog rgyu sogs mi mdzad/ bza' btung nam gyi dus yang dbu mdzad nas brel ba mi slong bar tshogs pa gcig gis gsol ma tshar yang de'i bar brgug pa las 'don 24)mgo len pa sogs mi mdzad/ 'don pa rgyas pa mi tshar ba'i dogs pa mi dgos/ rgyas pa ma tshar na bsdus pa bton chog rgyas bsdus mang po gu ru rin po che'i zab gter yid bzhin nor bu rnams la yod pa'ang*/ khams lcogs dang bstun dgos pa'i don yin/ tshogs gral chen po'i skabs su tshar grangs mi gsog pa'i dogs pa mi dgos/ gdangs dbyangs dang bcas pa'i cho ga tshar gcig bton na tshar brgya re 'don pa las kyang phan yon che/ gdangs dbyangs med pa'i cho ga tshe gcig bton kyang grub brtags bzang po sne gcig med pa 'di tsho gsang sngags kyi cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa'i skyon yin/ gdangs dbyangs dang bcas pa'i bdun sgrub re la'ang dngos nyams rmi lam tshun la rtags mtshan bzang po re mi 'ong mi srid/ de cho ga'i yan lag tshang ba'i yon tan yin 25)pas/ rgyud gsang ba snying po las/ glu tshig sgra yis phyag rgya yis// chos kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs bzhin phan yon che bas thams cad nas gdangs dbyangs kyi tshe rang skad che chung la ma ltos par gre ba'i gding nas 'u ru ru btang na cung zad 'bugs mo re med mi srid pas/ gdangs gyer dus kha rog blta mi 'dug par dbu mdzad dag gi skad la bsgrigs te 'u ru ru 'then dgos/ dbu mdzad rnams nas gdangs dbyangs rnams cho ga rang rang gi gter ston grub thob chen po so so'i phyag bzhes bzhin zhun mthar bcad nas sbyangs bstson mdzad de gra zur zhig kyang ma nyams par mdzad pa las/

rang gzo/ pho tshod/ shes rlom/ hang khyer rigs gtan nas mi mdzad par yid ches khungs btsun brgyud pa'i byin 26)rlabs ldan pa'i gsung gdangs rnams dag gtsang re gyer bar mdzad na/ byin rlabs kyi drod 'bebs/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ma mthong*/ rtogs pa na 'phar/ nyams ban bun g.yo/ mngon gsum gyi ye shes mthong ba sogs dgos pa du ma yod pas gzab la gyer/ gdangs dbyangs lag len cung zad nor 'phrul song yang*/ ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrug srung ma'i bka' chad 'ong bas dran shes bag yod gsum gyi skya bar nas 'don pa gal che/ ḍā dril dkraul ba'i tshe yang*/ ḍā ru len ran pa'i dus su byings nas gcig gis kyang snga len phyi len med par lhan gcig tu blang*/ dkrol ba'i tshe bla ma'i phyag ḍā la mig zur gyis gtad nas mi gcig gis dkrol ba lta bu las/ la las nang rdeb/ la las phyir rdeb lta bu cha mi mtshungs pa mi chog cing*/ nang rdab shed che ba 27)ba dang*/ phyir rdeb shed chung ba/ sgra la nyan pas/ 'theng 'gros go ba lta bu de ḍā ru 'khrol ba'i skyon che shos yin/ 'ur phab dus kyang 'theng mi shor bar dal brel mi gcig gis dkrol ba lta bu/ bcad dus khrob zhes sgra gcig gis gcod pa las/ ḍā rdil phyi nang mang por phog shor nas/ khrob be khrob bi bcad pa de tsho dang*/ 'ur phab tshar dus de ma thag thar zhes gcod pa las/ gcod mi thub par 'ur cung zad lhod nas ga ler bcad pa de tsho ḍā ru dkrol ba la skyon che/ ḍā ru dkrol tshar nas/ yang du dkrol mi dgos pa'i tshe de ma thag mdun rkyags la bzhag ḍā ru dkrol dus rdo rje pang du bzhag pa bka' ma'i lugs gtso bo yin/ gter ma'i dus/ ḍā ru dkrol ran pa dang*/ rdo rje mdun lcog steng bzhag pa dang ḍā ru blangs 28)nas dkrol/ ḍā ru dkrol tshar nas bzhag pa dang*/ de ma thag rdo rje blang dgos/ dung chen/ rkang dung*/ bshugs pa/ rgya gling*/ dung dkar rnams kyang 'bud tshig sngon gyi rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin du/

brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa las snyan rgyud zab mo legs par zhus nas nor med 'chugs med 'bud dkrol bya ba las/ ga yag gar mdzes rang gzo pho tshod gtan nas mi mdzad/ 'bud mi 'bud kyi mtshams kyang sngon gyi phyag srol ji lta ba bzhin dang*/ bka' ma'i dus bka' ma'i lugs kyi gyer brdung 'bud gsum ji blta ba las/ gter ma'i lugs gtan nas ma 'dres pa/ gter ma'i dus/ gter ma'i lugs kyi gyer brdung 'bud gsum rang rkang tshugs pa las bka' ma dang ma 'dres pa/ zhib par gter ma la'ang gter ston so so'i phyag bzhes mi mthun pa mang 29)du yod pas gcig dpe kun 'geb/ zhwa dpe lh+wam 'geb/ mun nag mdzub g.yugs lta bur ma song bar snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa yod pa la zhib rtsad bcad nas rtag gus kyi brtson 'grus drag pos sbyang brtson dang*/ shes pa de la ga len ji lta ba bzhin mdzad pa las/ bla chos des chog sogs rnam pa kun tu mi rung*/ gsang sngags 'di shin tu bka' gnyan/ srung ma dam can rgya mtsho yul ris gzhi bdag dang bcas pa la/ chos tshig gcig lag len zur tsam/ 'bud dkrol sne gcig tshun chad/ de rnams la gnyer du gtad yod pas tshul dang mthun pa byed mkhan la stong grogs byed/ tshul dang mi mthun pa cung zad byung yang de la chad pa gcod 'ong bas shin tu gzab dgos/ tshogs grol ba'i dus kyang gral mtha' nas mdud pa 30)zhig pa ltar lha khang sgo kha bar gzan zlum khyer gyis/ rdog sgra sogs med par 'jam wa ler pheb/ sgo rgyab nas gzan gal khyer gyis lham bzhes nas nang bskor re re mdzad srol dang*/ dus chen dus rgyang bskor re re phebs pa 'di tsho ma chad na sngon byon dam pa'i phyag bzhes zla dang bral ba yin/ bskor ba sogs la byon tshe yang*/ gtam chen por smra ba/ rtsed mo ha bgad sogs bag med rigs spang nas dran shes bag yod dang ldan pas 'jam lhan ner phebs dgos/ tshogs nam grol dus/

bsgrigs chen skabs yar tshogs spyad 'du khang sgo kha nas dung dkar 'bud pa dang*/ bslab gral ltar gzan zlum khyer gyis nang du phebs nas dung dkar rdzogs pa dang tshogs pa thams cad nang du rdzogs dgos/ dus chen skabs rgya rnga'i bskul ba dang*/ dung dkar gyis nang du 'dus pa sogs bya/ dge tshul 31)slong rnams kyis tshogs grol ba dang chos gos phud nas rang rang gi gdan la bzhi lteb kyis 'jog nang du gral la 'khod ste chos gos bzhes nas dge 'dun rnams dang lhan gcig tu gral phyag gsum re 'tshal nas bzhugs pa nam tshogs la 'dra/ tshogs grol ran pa'i dus dge g.yog chab ril pa gnyis nas chab 'grim pa dang*/ bzed zhal bzed tshul tsam gral du yod la 'grim tsam byas pa dang*/ dge 'dun pa thams cad kyis phyag g.yas pa brkyang nas bzung ba'i tshul dang*/ bzed zhal du lugs pa'i tshul tsam mdzad dgos/ lham sgo khang du phud nas tshogs rgyu 'di snga 'gyur rnying ma spyi'i tshogs bsgrigs yin kyang stabs cung zad mi bde bas dbang chos sogs zhu rgyu yod dus phud/ rgyun du lh+wam gyon nas tshogs bzhag kyang nyes pa med pas/ de ltar 32)byed tshe dge 'dun spyi nas lham gyon nas tshogs na mdo lugs dang mi mthun yang gsang sngags lugs la 'gal ba med/ dge tshul slong rnams gding ba la bzhugs dus lham nges par tu phud dgos/ de'i tshe dge tshul slong rnams la phud gyon bde ba'i lham mgo rkyang pa re yod na shin tu bde/ bsgrigs chen dus zhog ja la/ dge g.yog chab ril pa gcig gis dge bskos kyi gding ba bting*/ gcig gis rtse zhwa bzung*/ ja mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ hrīḥbla ma yi dam/ zhes pa dang*/ 'jig rten mchod 'os pa'i thub dbang rgyal ba sras bcas/ zhes pa'i skabs dge bskos nas phyag gsum 'tshal/ ja mchod tshig rdzogs pa dang*/ rtse zhwa lag g.yon steng*/ rtse g.yon bstan gyis 'dud rgya bcas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/

de ring gi tshe mang 33)ja gnang bar 'os pa rnams la gnang ba thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu/ zhes brjod 'phral/ rtse zhwa chab ril par gtad/ rang khri la 'khod de gsol zhal bkyags/ dbu mdzad pas/ dge bskos kyi zhus zin pa dang*/ mgo bskul te 'dus pa thams cad kyis/ ji bder longs spyod/ ces lan btab/ nyin gzhung gung tshig dkon mchog rjes dran phud mchod sogs ji lta ba 'don pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa de ni yang dag spel/ zhes pa'i rjes sam/ dus rgyun gung tshig mi 'don pa'i tshe shar tshogs grol ran pa dang*/ sngar ltar gyis ge bskos nas phyag gsum dag 'dud rgyas/ bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed dam par gyur pa mkhan po 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po dge slong dge ba'i bshes gnyen thub bstan khri rin po dge slong yin na dang 34)min na rdor 'dzin rgyal tshab pa'i mtshan nas brjod de/ zhes bgyi ba'i zhal snga nas gtsor mdzad/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ deng zla ba tshes gcig lta bu la/ yar gyi ngo yi gral tshes gcig pa zhes pa dang*/ tshes bcu drug pa lta bu la/ mar gyi ngo yi gral tshes gcig pa gang ltar yang*/ mngon du gyur pa lags pas gcug lag khag gi bdag po dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi lha rnams kyi slad du zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa re bklag du gsol/ zhes brjod pa dang*/ mtshan nas brjod pa'i dge slong des mgo bskul nas se gol dang bcas/ dge bar gsungs shig zhes dang*/ de ma thag bskul te/ skar ma rab rib sogs dang*/ chos rnams thams cad sogs/ sdig pa ci yang sogs dang*/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs dang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sogs dang*/ klu rgyal dga' bo 35)sogs dang*/ 'jig rten bde zhing sogs brjod/ de nas gung tshigs 'phros yin na zab mdo bdud bzlog bcas dang*/ ltung bshags btang*/ shar tshogs dus yin na/ 'jig rten bde zhing 'phros su/ byang 'dren pas snang grags rig sum sogs kyis grol dgos so/

zhog tshogs kyi tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang*/ gter ma'i rigs la hrīḥsngon bskal ma btang ba'i tshe/ chab ril pa gcig gis gding ba gting*/ gcig shos kyis spos bam mdzod dar can dang*/ rtse zhwa bzung*/ dge bskos kyi phyag gsum mdzad nas rtse zhwa bzhes/ zla gam yod na bzhes bzhin pas spos bskor rdo rje rgyal po dang dkyil 'khor la bdun bskor/ rgyal tshab/ rgyal theb rnams la lnga bskor/ 'dus pa byings la gsum bskor re mdzad zin nas zhwa phud nas rang gral bzhugs/ las rdor pas/ dkyil 'khor dang mchod 36)rdzas la kha rlangs ma phog bar gtsang sbra dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ gter ma'i lugs la tshon na/ mchod pa byin rlabs bsang chu bran/ skyabs sems mthar maṇḍal yod pa'i rigs la maṇḍal 'thor nas 'gyed/ dkar bgegs byin rlabs/ so sor bsang chu bran/ dkar gtor lte thad bzung la dor/ bgegs bskrad dus spos phor du gu gul nag po bdug la gral du 'grim/ byin 'bebs yod pa rnams la las rdor gcig gis/ dkyil 'khor la phyogs par g.yab dar 'phen/ gcig gi spos skor bya/ phyi mchod byin rlabs la mchod pa rnams la bsang chu gtor/ sman byin rlabs la lag g.yas sman thod zhal kheb blang*/ g.yon pas sbreng thur gyis/ g.yon du 37)lan gsum dkrug rakta byin rlabs la g.yon pas kheb bsal te/ g.yas pas g.yas su lan gsum dkrug gtor ma byin rlabs dus sman gtor la sman gyis bran/ sbreng tshar gyis mar me dang*/ spos sbar/ spyan 'dren dus g.yab dar dang spos bskor sngar bzhin/ phyi mchod sogs tshar nas/ sman dus/ sbreng thur gyis/ rtsa gsum sogs gtor ma yongs rdzogs la bran pa'i tshul gyis mchod/ rakta dus/ sbreng thur gyi rakta phyar/ gtor ma dus sman rakta gnyis ka gtor ma rnams la bran nas mtheb skyus gtor ma thams cad gso/ de nas 'dzab kyi stong tshig mchod pa la/ nas dang chus mchod pa kha gso/ mar me dang spos thur/

zhal zas gsar pa re yang mchod/ rnam bum sgrub pa yod pa'irigs la/ rnam bum steng du dung zhal bzhag 38)de'i steng gzungs thag rdo rje bzhag nas/ mchod pa sogs rgyas spros yod rigs la/ mar me dang spos thur/ zhal zas gsar pa re res mchod pa dang*/ mchod pa kha gso rgyu 'di/ rjes chog mchod bstod yan/ arghaṃ padyaṃ kyi sngags dang*/ mchod pa'i tshig bcad nam byung byung la dgos pas chad mi nyan/ bsnyen pa'i skabs/ nas thor/ pad bskor gyis gzungs thag blang nas slob dpon la phul/ slob dpon gyis kyang de bzhin du blang nas thugs kar 'dzin/ bsnyen pa rdzogs la nye ba dang*/ gzungs rdor las rdor la gnang ba re zhig ci bder 'jog 'od zhu skabs dung zhal gyi chu bum par blugs/ de ltar bum sgrub kyi phyag len 'di rigs dkar gling zhi khro lta bu'i las bum sgrub pa rgyas pa yod rigs la'ang*/ dung zhal dang gzungs thag rigs snga ma ltar tshogs gral du bsgrigs chen sogs la 39)nges par dgos ma gtogs za 'dod 'bul 'tsher gyis ma dag rgyun 'byams kyi 'phro brkyang gtan nas mi mdzad pa bka' drin che/ las bum sgrub tshar nas/ de ring dbang bskur dgos tshe gzungs thag rnam bum kha rgyan la dkri dgos/ dbang bskur mi dgos tshe ci bder 'jog de nas gsol ka sogs la/ chos skyong rang rang gi 'bul gtor dang*/ gser skyems bshams/ gtor ma la sman raka bran/ spyan 'dren nam byung la g.yab dar 'phen/ tshogs la bza' ba rnams g.yas/ btung ba rnams g.yon du gshams/ bsang chu dang*/ tshogs chang dang*/ bla ma'i nang mchod yod na dang med tshe dkyil 'khor mdun gyi sman phud bran/ tshogs spyan 'dren ma byas pa'i sngon nam rjes su tshogs phud bcad/ de dum bzhir bgos pa dang*/ tshogs chang btegs la tshogs dang po'i skabs/ rtsa 40)gsum dang*/ chos skyong gtor ma'i bzed zhal so sor 'bul/ bar pa bshags pa'ang de bzhin dang*/ tshogs tha ma'i dus su/

tshogs ling ngam bcad pa'i tshogs la rakta bran la slob dpon mdun du bkod/ liṅga yod na/ gter phyogs la mgo bo slob dpon phyogs dang*/ bka' ma'i phyogs la rkang ba slob dpon la phyogs par bkod/ slob dpon gyis bsgral zin nas/ nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi phud skyogs kyi blangs pa dang chabs gcig ling ro dkyil 'khor mdun btegs la/ zhal bstab dus bzed zhal rnams su 'bul/ bla rgyud bskong ba'i dus/ tshogs las rig 'dzin tshogs phud blangs ba sman gtor mdun phul/ gzhung gi bskang ba'i dus gtor ma rnams gso bran legs par bya/ tshogs drang ba la/ bza' ba g.yas dang*/ btung ba g.yon pas btegs/ slob dpon thob thang can dang*/ spang rtogs yon tan can yin na tshogs chang thod pa'i khar 41)phud skyogs kyi yu ba slob dpon la phyogs par bkod de/ mdun du btegs pas slob dpon nyid kyis phud skyogs kyis blang chog pa dgos/ gzhan rnams la tshogs dang tshogs chang rim par 'gyed/ tshogs gral du sdom ldan gtsang ma kho na tshogs dus/ 'di skabs tshogs rdzas thams cad 'gyed nas/ gsol lhag bsdu dgos pa dang*/ dam tshig ldan mi ldan 'dres ma tshogs pa la/ tshogs zan lhag ma'i rjes su 'gyed pa las lhag ma ma bsdus na legs zhes rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab kyis thugs gsang sgrub chen las 'grigs kun gsal dri med las gsungs pas/ tshogs bsgrigs yod dus lhag ma bsdu dgos/ cho ga bsdus pa'i la rigs la/ lhag ma byin rlabs dus slob dpon gyi phyag g.yon par phud skyogs kyis tshogs chang blugs/ lag g.yas pas lhag ma bzung ste zhal phru zhu dgos/ cho ga rgyas 42)pa yar gnas mar gnas so sor yod pa la/ lhag phud nas dum gcig phud gtor mdun du bzed zhal du phul/ de nas dum gcig blangs tai lhag ma'i steng 'jog gtsang lhag sngar rig 'dzin tshogs phud rjes su/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi gsol tshogs/ de rjes gtsang lhag blangs ba dum bu nyer brgyad byas pa de bzhin/

gtsang lhag de brtsog lhag steng du spungs/ slob dpon la zhal khru zhu/ dkyil 'khor mdun zhing lpags khar mañdzi'i khar bkod/ sman raka bran/ dpal me bcas bzhugs/ zhwa gyon/ sman rag sbreng thur gyis blangs te/ bsnol ma'i steng*/ lhag ma'i gtor ma bzung*/ zhabs su bshal chu bzung ste/ phyir nud gom gsum 'phror/ phyi rol gtsang sar gtor stegs steng spungs/ sman raka bran/ bshal chus gtor gzhong bshal ste mtha' bskor du blugs/ snod kha phyir bstan dang 43)zhwa phrag bkal gyis nang du phebs/ dkar gtor la bdud rtsi bran/ theb tu bshams pa btegs la phyi rol gtsang sar phul/ gtor 'gugs dus/ chad bstan snod so sor bshams pa la rakta bran/ 'gugs pa zin pa dang*/ sman bran/ bskul pa la phug gtor yongs rdzogs la sman raka lan gsum sbreng*/ mtheb skyu gsum res gso/ gsol ka'i gtor ma bkyag rgyu yod rigs la/ lag g.yon gyis/ mdzub mo/ mthe'u chung steng*/ gung srin zhabs su sman raka sbreng thur bsnol mar bzung*/ 'di sbreng thur nam bzung kyang 'dra/ de steng skyems phud bzhag zhwa gyon/ g.yas kyi 'bul gtor me sgron btsugs pa btegs la/ 'du khang sgo kha nas slob dpon la phyogs par bkyags/ slob dpon gyi 'thor nas gnang ba dang phyir gtsang sar 'bul/ zhwa phab te nang du log 44)sman rag sbreng thur sngar ltar bzung ba'i steng brtan gtor du/ sngar gtor ma 'bul snod bshal ba'i chu blugs nas zhal nang bstan gyis lte thad du bzung*/ zhwa bzhes/ phyag g.yas pas chad tho'i gtor ma me sgron btsugs pa zhal phyir bstan nam mkhar btegs pa sgo kha nas slob dpon la phyogs par bzung*/ slob dpon gyis 'thor nas dang bstun/ phyi rol du 'gro lam chad tho'i rtse'i dkar rgyan sgo la glan te/ phyi rgyab nas chad tho zor du 'phen tshul dang*/ brtan gtor sman rag gis bran pa gtor stegs la bkod/ de nas bro 'gugs gsum tshar dus zhwa gyon bzhin du nang du log nas gtor gzhong gnyis gral mdor sbubs/

gdangs gral gzhung nas 'ong ste slob dpon gyi rdo rje zhu/ gtor gzhong steng rgya gram du bkod nas zhwa phud/ gtor gzhong la g.yas skor dang*/ gdangs gral g.yas pa'i rgyab nas mar 45)'ong ste slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas par thug pa dang rdo rje phul/ slob dpon rgyab dang*/ gdangs gral g.yon pa'i rgyab nas bskor te/ rta bro tshar nas/ bdag cag mchog sgrub dus gtor gzhong kha zed la nang du nas 'thor/ rjes chog mchod bstod la mchod pa kha gso/ mar me dang spos sbar/ sman rag bran/ gtor ma gsos/ dngos grub len pa la/ thod chang sogs dbang rdzas 'gyed/ nongs bshags la gral mdo nas phyag gsum 'tshal/ 'dis mtshon cho ga'i gzhung la phyag 'tshal nam byung la phyag 'tshal dgos/ rten bzhugs la me tog 'thor zin pa dang*/ de nyin grol ba yin na bsdu rim dus dkyil 'khor sgrub rten gtso gras rnams bsdu/ de nas lhar ldang go bsgo lus bsrung rnams grub rjes/ bsngo smon dus bkra shis 'thor nas 'gyed/ de nas bkra shis brjod pas dge legs kyi 46)snang ba chen pos phyogs dus kun tu khyab par bya'o/ las byang gi bskul chad bstan nas/ 'di yi bar 'dus pa byings nas zhwa bzhes dgos/ gzhan byin 'bebs dang*/ spyan 'dren/ bka' srung gi bskong ba bcas la zhwa dgos pa yod/ 'di ni lho gter phyogs kyi lag len gtso bor smos pa yin/ byang gter la gzhan yod do/ khyad par snga 'gyur bka' ma rin po che la tshogs spro lugs sogs dmigs bsal re 'ga' ni snga 'gyur bstan pa rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas sa la spyod pa'i 'og min o rgyan smin grol gling nges pa don gyi dga' ba'i tshal chen po'i mkhas dang grub pa brnyes pa'i rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes dri ma med pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dgos 'byung dbang gi rgyal po chen po ji lta ba bzhin las rtogs dgos pas gzhan du shes par bya'o//

dge tshogs ston zla ku mud ltar dkar 47)bas// dkar phyogs ru mtshon dgung du sbreng ba dang*// nag phyogs bdud dgra'i phru ma gzhom byas te// dge legs snang bas sa chen khyab gyur cig /ces pa'ang karma theg mchog snying po dri med yongs grub rgyas pa'i sde'i zhal snga nas bskul ba bzhin rig pa 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// sarba maṅga laṃ// 48)
